name: connect-base-create
description: What: Make the Connect baseline of one Profisee version on this box: wait for any TestAuto run, check whether this version's baseline already exists (when it does, skip everything else and end green: nothing is overwritten), then run connect-1k-bootstrap-main-only (it REPLACES the Main Profisee database with the seed backup connect/databases:BaseSeedBackupFileName and runs Profisee Configuration on it, then API key, legacy cleanup, Main model build, SQL export table, Connect setup), which ends with the baseline backup profisee_ConnectBaseline_PDATA_<version code>.bak of Main. Why: every Connect test run resets Main to the baseline of its version; connect-preflight fails until it exists. When: once per box and version, after the Profisee of that version is installed. For a new version run connect-setup (it creates this version's TestAuto workflows) and connect-base-create: setup also writes the baseline, so run this workload before connect-setup (a round starts it first); once setup has made the baseline this workload skips the bootstrap and ends green. Needs: the connect/* reference sets (or a lane's version parameters) and the box's secrets; the seed backup in the SQL Server default backup folder of connect/machines:DatabaseServerName; the install pack on this box; no test running against this Profisee database. It never touches the Profisee to Profisee target and never overwrites a baseline. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: open the first failed step; for the bootstrap, the run output of connect-1k-bootstrap-main-only names what to check.
globalParametersNotes: BaseMissing is set by the check step during the run (true or false); it starts as false so the bootstrap is skipped, never run, when the answer is missing.

inline.description: What: Wait for any TestAuto run already in progress on this box. Why: the bootstrap restarts IIS on the Main application server and rebuilds the Main model, which would break a running test. Success: no run is active. If it fails: TestAuto is unreachable on port 8443.

What: Look for the Connect baseline of this version (profisee_ConnectBaseline_PDATA_<version code>.bak) in the SQL Server default backup folder of connect/machines:DatabaseServerName and keep the answer in the run parameter BaseMissing (true = no baseline yet). Why: this workload makes a baseline once and never overwrites one; every test run resets Main to it, so when it exists the bootstrap step is skipped and the run ends green. Success: the step ends without an error (it does not fail when the baseline exists). If it fails: the database server does not answer, or the CrewChief account cannot connect to master there.

What: Print whether the Connect baseline of this version already exists (nothing done) or will be made. Why: the run output then says plainly why the bootstrap step is Skipped. Success: one line is printed. If it fails: the script cannot fail by itself; open the run output of the check step before it.

What: Build the Main side of the Connect pack and back it up as the baseline of this version (profisee_ConnectBaseline_PDATA_<version code>.bak). Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-1k-bootstrap-main-only' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-1k-bootstrap-main-only'; its first failed step says what to check. Skipped when: the Connect baseline of this version already exists (the check step found it), so there is nothing to make.

steps.label: Bootstrap Main And Back Up The Baseline
